FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 186
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/02/2026
Senate Bill 186 as introduced would authorize the issuance of a distinctive motor vehicle
license plate to individuals diagnosed with invisible disabilities and to the primary caregivers of
those individuals upon payment of the standard $23 issuance fee and an additional annual fee of
$40 to be distributed as follows:
2.5% Commission to License Plate Issuing Official $1.00
Department of Corrections $1.50
Department of Revenue-Administrative Cost $1.00
Kulturecity, Incorporated $36.50
Total $40.00
